headline: Discussion of the contract for Turnstone.
summary: The main item is a discussion of the Turnstone contract. Other old or new business may also come up.
plain_text:
CITY OF NASHUA                NEW HAMPSHIRE 
 
TRUSTEES OF 
     THE EDGEWOOD/SUBURBAN CEMETERIES 
Incorporated March 24, 1893 
 
                                                            November 25,2026   
                                                          
 
 
Edgewood/Suburban Cemetery Trustees, 
 
 
 
There will be an Edgewood/Suburban Cemetery Meeting on  
December 1,2026 at 3:30PM in the Cemetery Chapel. 
 
 
 
                                                         Agenda 
 
 
 
1. Call meeting to order. 
2. Attendance. 
3. Approval of minutes from the October 28,2026 meeting. 
4. Notice of meeting. 
5. Discuss Contract for Turnstone. 
6. Any old or new business that may come before the board. 
7. Adjourn.  
 
 
 
 
 
 
              107 Amherst St., Nashua, NH 03064-2578 / Telephone (603)594-3327
